``` {r}
## library packages

library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

```


```{r}
## read in data

censoc <- read_csv(file = "~/Downloads/censoc_numident_demo_v2.1.csv")

censoc %>%
  head()

censoc %>%
  tail()

censoc %>% 
  colnames()

```

## new filter exercise

here we will be doing data filtering

```{r}
censoc %>% 
  filter(byear == 1919)

censoc_1919_or_later <- censoc%>% 
  filter(byear > 1919)

censoc_filter 2 <- censoc %>% 
  filter(byear => 1910 & byear =< 1920)

censoc_filter <- censoc %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920)

censoc %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  filter(socstate_string == "California" | socstate_string == "Texas")


```


# selecting

```{r}
censoc %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  select(-histid)

censoc %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  select(-c("histid", "bmonth", "dyear"))

censoc %>% 
  filter(byear %in% 1910:1920) %>% 
  select()
```


## mutate

```{r}

## 
censoc %>% 
  select(histid, dyear) %>% 
  mutate(dyear_plus_ten = dyear + 10)


```


## summarize

```{r}
censoc %>% 
  summarize(mean(byear))

censoc %>% 
  summarize(mean_byear = mean(byear),
           median_byear = median(byear))
```

## groups

```{r}
censoc %>% 
  group_by(bpl_string) %>% 
  summarize(mean(death_age))
```

## filter

```{r}
censoc %>% 
  filter(byear == 1910) %>% 
  group_by(bpl_string) %>% 
  summarize(mean(death_age))
```

## ggplot

```{r}
install.packages("cowplot")

censoc %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = dyear), binwidth = 1, fill = "gray", color = "black" + 
      theme_cowplot()


censoc %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = dyear), binwidth = 1, fill = "gray", color = "black") + theme_cowplot() + labs (x = "Death Year",  y = "")

```
